import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.next();

        int atPos = s.indexOf("at", 1);
        if (atPos != -1) {
            s = s.substring(0, atPos) + "@" + s.substring(atPos + 2);
        }

        int dotPos;
        while ((dotPos = s.indexOf("dot", 1)) != -1 && dotPos <= s.length() - 4) {
            s = s.substring(0, dotPos) + "." + s.substring(dotPos + 3);
        }

        System.out.println(s);
    }
}
